title: A direct line for bugs, and a place for updates
summary: Report a problem privately and keep up with what changes in Radon.
changes: Use /bug to send a bug report directly to Radon's owner. Reports are saved privately, with a reference you can keep.
Spam, false reports, and abuse will lead to a ban from using the bot. Never include passwords, tokens, or private account codes in a report.
Use /updates to read the latest changes, or choose an older update with the release option. The website now has the same update history.
The website has smoother motion, clearer navigation on guide and legal pages, and improved search and sharing metadata.

title: More games, optional vote rewards, and clearer guides
summary: The same claiming workflow now supports three games, with optional extras for supporters.
changes: Claim coupons for Solo Leveling: ARISE, Seven Knights Re:BIRTH, and The Seven Deadly Sins: Idle Adventure. Existing Solo Leveling accounts and CLAIM buttons keep working.
A verified vote on either Top.gg or Discord Bot List unlocks a 24-hour Supporter Pass: ten saved accounts per game and optional coupon alerts. Free claiming and five saved accounts remain available.
Use /guide for claiming, voting, troubleshooting, moderation cases, and AutoMod. Command replies now use clearer cards and private staff views.
